items.title: The locus where a flat finitely presented module is etale locally free is open and stable under base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a locally finitely presented morphism of algebraic spaces and a finitely presented module flat over the target, the lemma shows that the set of points where the module is free in an etale neighbourhood is open and that its formation commutes with arbitrary base change. The proof applies the pointwise freeness criterion to identify the locus with a constructible set, then uses flatness and finite presentation to upgrade constructibility to openness, and finally compares the locus with the corresponding locus after base change. The comparison with base change is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 6001-6040.
